entry.title: Primo Brands opens first new factory post merger
entry.summary: The Arkansas plant will increase production for sparkling water brand Mountain Valley as demand for premium beverages surges.

entry.title: Extended peak season drives high dwell times at San Pedro Bay ports
entry.summary: The Pacific Merchant Shipping Association said record volumes in September pushed up the time cargo remained idle, both for rail and truck transport.

entry.title: Apple expands US supplier network for iPhone materials, components
entry.summary: The company added a new titanium supplier and expanded its partnership with an advanced film maker as part of a $600 billion commitment to U.S. manufacturing.

entry.title: Hydro Flask maker aims tariff refunds at inventory, packaging
entry.summary: Helen of Troy plans to spend a portion of its expected $80.5 million refund to clean stock and refresh packaging design.

entry.title: Stord expands network with AMS Fulfillment purchase
entry.summary: The acquisition bolsters Stord's presence in key East Coast and West Coast hubs while building upon other recent deals.

entry.title: Nestlé to close Ohio factory by end of 2027
entry.summary: The food giant will move production to South Carolina, saying it is "the most sustainable path forward" as consumer needs and volumes shift.

entry.title: Ikea accused of harmful wood sourcing in Europe’s forests
entry.summary: Greenpeace International alleges the furniture maker — which has long faced backlash over its sourcing — is falling short in its efforts to protect biodiversity.

entry.title: Medtech execs share secrets to building resilient supply chains
entry.summary: At AdvaMed’s The MedTech Conference, company executives said they’re bracing for disruption by investing in inventory, scenario planning and their relationships with chip suppliers.

entry.title: Levi’s distribution network transition saga continues to drag
entry.summary: The retailer now expects to begin seeing benefits from the in 2027 due to a facility fire during Q3 and the complexity of its SKU mix.

entry.title: DHL boosts US-Asia cold chain connectivity for healthcare shippers
entry.summary: DHL Global Forwarding has added air freight corridors connecting Cincinnati with key hubs in Asia for temperature-sensitive goods.
